description: Main React component for a Tic Tac Toe web game, including game logic, UI controls, settings, score tracking, and match history.

methods.name: generateWinLines
methods.description: Generates all winning line combinations for an N x N Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: calculateWinnerGeneric
methods.description: Determines the winner for a given board state and size.

methods.name: getAvailableMoves
methods.description: Returns list of indices of available moves on the board.

methods.name: aiMoveEasy
methods.description: AI move strategy for easy difficulty, selects a random available move.

methods.name: aiMoveNormal
methods.description: AI move strategy for normal difficulty, attempts to win, block, or pick strategic positions.

methods.name: aiMoveHard
methods.description: AI move strategy for hard difficulty, uses minimax for 3x3 boards, falls back to normal for larger.

methods.name: playSound
methods.description: Plays a sound effect based on game events, respecting mute setting.
